_how_to_use: Each property is one block in the 'projects' list, shown on the Projects page in this order.
'image' is a photo file in site/img/ (for example 'bricks-court.jpg'). Leave it empty to show a plain card without a photo.
'type', 'summary' and 'services' are optional. Fill them in as you get the details; empty ones are simply not shown.
'services' can include any of: Facility management, Janitorial services, Post-construction cleaning, Real estate services.
Set 'published' to false to hide a property without deleting it.
After editing, run: python build.py   then commit and push.
